items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Interviewee does not mention Kim Sisters; Interviewer mentions them in relation to Mr. Gallagher.

ctx.x: No, last Saturday I was down in Florida. I haven't done it -- the band I was in sort of broke up about 10 years ago. And actually, I think the Sanitation Department took it over. They have a pipe band now and they wear the same kilt that we wore. And Mr. Gallagher retired to Las Vegas or some place.

He wound up traveling with the Kim Sisters, do you remember them? Three Korean girls that played all the instruments. And they decided they wanted to learn bagpipe, and they must have given him a fortune because he packed it in and went off with the Kim Sisters.
And he was an artist. God, he was a great piper.
